name: copilot-agent-mesh
description: Preview mesh coordinator; experimental Worker hosting is limited to macOS arm64.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Copilot Agent Mesh can delegate coding tasks. Worker Preview execution is supported only on macOS arm64.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Remote task execution requires local filesystem-backed workspaces.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_list_workers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists a bounded opaque Device -> Node -> Workspace hierarchy. Call this before delegating to obtain every explicit target ID. Results contain routing/status/capability metadata only, never paths, prompts, secrets, or raw task output.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List available mesh devices, window nodes, and workspaces without exposing filesystem paths.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_delegate_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delegates a coding task to one explicit Device -> Node -> Workspace target from mesh_list_workers. deviceId, nodeId, nodeInstanceId, and workspaceId are always required; optional peerId is internal remote routing metadata and never replaces those IDs. Omit delegationRequestId for a fresh user invocation; the tool generates and returns one. Reuse that ID only to retry the exact same payload, which recovers the same task; the same ID with a different payload conflicts. Returns after durable broker acceptance and before Agent startup completes with a pending task ID; use mesh_get_task to poll startup and terminal outcomes. Under a small token budget, compact JSON uses s state (0 accepted pending, 1 reconcile the same intent, 2 error, 3 persistence pending), t taskId, d delegationRequestId, e stable error code, and r retry/reconciliation flag; s=1 or s=3 with r=1 means retry the exact same intent and ID. Do not use this tool for Git, branch, worktree, commit, push, or pull request management.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Start an asynchronous coding task on an explicitly selected device, node, and workspace.

delegationRequestId.description: Optional invocation identity. Omit for a fresh task; reuse the returned ID only for an exact retry.

deviceId.description: Explicit opaque target device ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

nodeId.description: Explicit opaque target node ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

nodeInstanceId.description: Explicit target node instance ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

workspaceId.description: Opaque workspace ID returned by mesh_list_workers.

peerId.description: Optional internal routing metadata for a remote device; it does not replace explicit target IDs.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Optional acceptance criteria; each item is limited to 4 KiB UTF-8.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_get_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a bounded snapshot and event summary for an asynchronous Copilot Agent Mesh task, including event-gap and truncation indicators. Event sequences are positive and consecutive; eventGap identifies every omitted leading event, while eventCursor always equals the last returned sequence or the requested afterEventSequence for an empty window. Recovering snapshots may retain pending input, but only needsInput snapshots expose mesh_answer_task. Failed and timedOut snapshots include safe failure code, message, and retryable fields. Never returns a raw transcript.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check a delegated task status and bounded results.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_cancel_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Requests cancellation of a task owned by this coordinator. This is the only mesh tool that turns a caller cancellation intent into a remote task cancellation request.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Request cancellation of a delegated task.

languageModelTools.name: mesh_answer_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Answers a pending question or approval request for a task owned by this coordinator. Use the exact task and input IDs from mesh_get_task plus a stable caller-generated answer ID for idempotent retries.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send an answer to a delegated task that is waiting for input.

taskId.description: Owned task ID waiting for input.

inputId.description: Pending input ID returned by mesh_get_task.

answerId.description: Stable answer ID used for idempotent retries.

copilotAgentMesh.deviceName.markdownDescription: The name used to identify this device to trusted peers.

copilotAgentMesh.codePath.markdownDescription: Optional VS Code CLI path used by the macOS arm64 Worker Preview Agent Host runtime. Other platforms are Coordinator-only.

copilotAgentMesh.experimental.agentHost.markdownDescription: Enable the real macOS arm64 Worker Preview Agent Host/AHP runtime. This may consume Copilot quota. Windows, Linux, macOS x64, and other architectures remain Coordinator-only.

copilotAgentMesh.experimental.authentica.markdownDescription: Maps an AHP protected-resource or authorization-server URL to a VS Code authentication provider ID and exact scopes. No provider or scope is inferred.

copilotAgentMesh.devTunnelPath.markdownDescription: User-supplied path to the exact supported macOS arm64 Dev Tunnel CLI `1.0.2030+fc9273aa0f` executable. Required for Worker Preview tunnel hosting. Other platforms are Coordinator-only. The extension never downloads, installs, discovers by PATH, or upgrades this CLI.

copilotAgentMesh.listener.port.markdownDescription: Preferred loopback Gateway port. Use 0 to restore the last owned port or allocate one on first start.

copilotAgentMesh.listener.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start the persisted Worker Preview listener during local Extension Host activation. Listener hosting is supported only on macOS arm64.

copilotAgentMesh.workspace.capabilityTag.markdownDescription: Capability tags published for newly registered workspaces. Paths and credentials must not be used as tags.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.bundle: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.package:vsix: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --pre-release --no-dependencies --out artifacts/copilot-agent-mesh-0.3.0-preview.vsix && npm run verify:vsix
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && node --test out/src/unitTest/*.test.js out/src/test/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:two-instance-real: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node scripts/e2e/two-instance/run.mjs
scripts.test:multi-window-real: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node scripts/e2e/multi-window/run.mjs
scripts.test:extension: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:component && npm run test:extension
scripts.verify: npm run test:unit && npm run test:component && npm run test:extension && npm run package:vsix
scripts.test:agent-host-auth-e2e: npm run compile-tests && node out/src/e2e/agentHost.e2e.js auth-boundary
scripts.test:agent-host-success-e2e: npm run compile-tests && node out/src/e2e/agentHost.e2e.js success-turn
